findings.reason: a solve node measuring the map sup at 2,000 cells fails the headline gate on a fixture artefact, and would either loosen the locked bound or re-scope §4 to fix the exterior, when the repair is to state the booking-term denominator in §6's row and bind it to f-cfs-exterior-on-exact-support.
findings.text: §6's acceptance table states "map fidelity at the analytic state, no solve ≤ 1e-2 relative sup" and its acceptance row moves the analytic certificate to "about 2,000, 5,000 and 10,000 cells", but the plan's own evidence measures the map sup at 2,098 cells as 0.0195 (proto-support, cited in the resolution-strategy decision and its evidence comment: "map sup 0.0187056/0.0194733/0.00940928 at 550/2098/5158, first <=0.01 at 5158"); only the booking term is 0.0090 there, and §4 reaches the bound solely by carving the exterior closure out to the followup f-cfs-exterior-on-exact-support ("Until that fixture lands, the certificate's exterior closure residual … is reported beside the map's own booking term"), while §6's row cites only "the exterior posed on the exact support", which the followup's own body says still leaves a 0.006-to-0.018 closure. As written §6's headline clause is not met at the lowest analytic rung on the plan's own numbers, and the two sections define the same gate with different denominators and different prerequisites.
